Let \(O\) be the origin, \(A\) the tip of \(\mathbf a\), and \(B\) the tip of \(\mathbf b\).

- The angle between \(\mathbf a=\overrightarrow{OA}\) and \(\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{OB}\) is \(29^\circ\), so \(\angle AOB=29^\circ\).
- The vector \(\mathbf a-\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{BA}\). The angle between \(\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{OB}\) and \(\overrightarrow{BA}\) is \(84^\circ\).  
  The interior angle at \(B\) is between \(\overrightarrow{BO}=-\mathbf b\) and \(\overrightarrow{BA}\), so
  \[
  \angle OBA=180^\circ-84^\circ=96^\circ.
  \]

Thus in triangle \(OAB\),
\[
\angle OAB=180^\circ-29^\circ-96^\circ=55^\circ.
\]

The angle between \(\mathbf a=\overrightarrow{OA}\) and \(\mathbf a-\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{BA}\) is the same as the angle between \(\overrightarrow{AO}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AB}\), which is \(\angle OAB\).

Therefore, the desired angle is

\[
\boxed{55^\circ}
\]
